cards.prompt:
PRODUCT-EVIDENCE PRECONDITIONS
Apply the task below only to parts, views and states supported for this actual SKU. Confirm necessary dimensions, materials, quantity and sale contents from SKU-specific records or the user; photos support only clearly visible appearance, not guessed measurements or material composition. A material name does not authorize unseen fibers, veins, seams, pores, gloss or hidden construction. Use details only where the actual source resolves them; sharpening, relighting or upscaling must not manufacture detail. If an indispensable fact, view or texture is missing or contradictory, ask the user for that specific input and wait before this dependent image. Request a clear same-product photo when needed. Do not infer an answer from templates, competitors, generated images or silence. Omit an optional unsupported claim; obtain a choice before changing a required view, panel count or information task. Design delegation covers styling, not product facts. New backgrounds and non-included props may follow the authorized design, but must not change merchandise identity or scale.

Create one photorealistic commercial product image.

Create two stacked residential scenes in one image: an upper close porch-and-garden usage view and a lower medium entrance view with front door, side wall lamps and steps. Separate them with a narrow dark-brown supplied-caption band, removing the band for a no-copy version.

With supplied copy allocate about 53 percent height to the upper scene, 4 percent to the middle caption band and 43 percent to the lower scene. An explicit no-copy choice removes the band and uses a 55/45 split. Keep the whole product forward above; below, matching products form two usage placements beside the central door. Keep each panel perspective coherent and merchandise identity consistent, using the actual supported hanging or standing method.

Use actual same-SKU photos for visible merchandise identity: resolved shape, color, connections and surface appearance. Establish material composition and sale contents separately from SKU records or user confirmation; a photographed container is not automatically included. Preserve supported internal composition and proportions within each instance while allowing the specified framing, lighting and placement.

The input white backdrop, original surroundings and studio shadow are not the output setting. Extract the product, build the complete environment specified below and relight it, rather than merely adjusting exposure on white.

Resolve support from the actual merchandise. Suspend a basket with genuine hook or chains from a plausible environmental fixing, keeping its original load path continuous and air below the base, with no tabletop placement or elliptical floor-contact shadow. Ground a floor or tabletop product on a real support. Do not add chains to a floor product or replace an included container to fit the setting.

Create a secondary two-panel lifestyle composition using the same actual product identity in both panels. Arrange supported usage contexts vertically with consistent visual color and a clean horizontal caption band between them. Keep each product instance naturally scaled, with coherent lighting within its own scene. Use only approved English wording already supplied; otherwise request the wording or wait for an explicit no-copy choice, which removes the band. Do not copy the reference slogan, add units to imply a set or convert unsupported hardware between product types.

If the requested layout includes a heading, feature caption, step description or other product copy, require the user to provide the corresponding wording for each text region. If wording is missing, ask the user to supply it or explicitly choose a no-copy version, and wait for that choice before producing the text-bearing graphic. Preserve supplied wording; translate only if the user requests it, without adding claims. Do not automatically write slogans, material claims, performance statements or decorative pseudo-text. An explicitly requested no-copy version removes heading and caption bars and returns their space to photographs; it still retains the verified measurements in a dimension image.

Preserve the prescribed banner or panel reading order and crop-safe product and copy areas on this task canvas; separately check the actual account upload slot.

Render as photorealistic commercial photography with readable merchandise and immediate support, physically coherent depth of field and source-supported material texture. Add no unsupported foliage or accessories. Render only explicitly supplied copy and add no feature badges or watermark. Preserve genuine existing product marks.

Before multiple placements, confirm whether they are simultaneous arrangements or separate alternative-use views. Map each actual product/color and allocated quantity to its container. For a simultaneous one-pack display, allocations must not exceed the confirmed pack contents; additional packs or separately sold products need an explicit display decision and clear purchase meaning. Do not clone a full pack into every container or mix variants by default.

Follow explicit user canvas and format instructions first. Otherwise return one finished sRGB PNG at 1464 by 600 px. Fit the prescribed regions into this canvas with the required product outline and annotations intact. Add no before-and-after comparison, design explanation or extra frame unless this task explicitly requires it. This is a desktop A+ production default, not verified acceptance by an account module; a confirmed actual upload-slot specification takes priority.

TYPOGRAPHY AND CLEARANCE
Use one readable type family for every visible word, number and unit in this image; vary size, weight, spacing and coordinated color within that family. Use expressive display forms only where readable. Preserve the selected source's title strip, angled panel, frame or colored footer when prescribed; do not force every image to brown/white or black type. Keep type, filled shapes, swashes and shadows outside the full merchandise plus breathing space. An explicit no-copy or native-text-only choice takes priority. A font name in a prompt is not proof of an actually loaded font.

cards.promptZh:
【产品事实前置条件】
以下任务只适用于本SKU已有依据的部位、视角与状态。必要尺寸、材质、件数和随货范围来自对应SKU资料或用户确认；照片只支持清楚可辨的外观，不能猜测实测值或材质成分。材料名称不授权补造看不清的纤维、叶脉、接缝、孔隙、光泽或内部结构；锐化、重布光和放大不能制造商品细节。必要事实、视角或纹理缺失或冲突时，先询问具体缺项，收到回答前暂停本张依赖图；需要时请求同款清晰实拍。不从模板、竞品、生成图或沉默推导答案。非必要且无依据的卖点可省略；更换必要视角、减少已选窗口或改变信息任务须先取得选择。设计委托不等于事实确认；可按授权设计背景和非随货道具，但不能改变商品身份或尺寸。

【输出目标】
生成一张真实商业商品摄影成图。

【目标环境】
在同一张图内创建上下两个住宅场景：上区为浅墙门廊与花园远景的商品近景，下区为住宅正门、两侧墙灯与台阶的入口中景。上、下区之间保留一条窄深棕色文案带，仅承载用户原文；无文案时取消文案带。

【构图与取景】
有文案版上区约53%、中间文字带约4%、下区约43%；用户明确选择无文案版时取消文字带，上下区改为55%与45%。上区完整商品居前景；下区同款商品在门两侧形成两个用途摆位，门为中轴背景。各区机位独立且透视成立，商品原色与内部结构一致；各展示位按商品真实挂接或承托方式呈现。

【输入用途】
同款实拍提供清楚可辨的形状、颜色、连接及表面外观。材质成分与随货范围另据对应SKU资料或用户确认，照片中的容器不自动视为随货。保留有依据的内部组成与比例；按本条规格调整取景、布光和摆放。

【背景替换】
输入商品照中的白底、原环境和棚拍影均不作为成品背景；提取商品后，直接生成下述完整环境并重新布光，不是在白底上仅调整曝光。

【摆放与受力】
按商品真实结构处理支撑：带挂钩或悬挂链的吊篮，使用其原挂件接到环境中的可信固定点，挂钩与链条连续受力，篮底下方留空气，不放在台面或地上，也不画篮底椭圆落地影；落地或台面款保持盆底贴合真实支撑面。不为套用环境给落地款新增挂链或更换随货盆。

【本款重点】
生成同款商品上下双场景拼版，上区为其支持的吊挂或台面近景，下区为住宅入口中景，原色一致、各区光影合理。中间统一横带原文：【填写中间文案原文；无字版填“无文案”】。无文案时移除横带；两个视图不表示两件装。

【文字与事实】
文案逐字使用用户提供的原文，未提供时先询问，或由用户明确选择无文案版；无文案时移除文字条，不能印占位符或开关说明。尺寸、件数、操作方法与工作状态只用用户资料，不从图片猜测。

【完成检查】
保留本款横幅或拼版的阅读顺序，重要商品部位与文字位于裁切安全区；使用本条画布，实际账户上传槽另行核对。

【商品保真】
成图为真实商业摄影：商品与近处承托或挂点清楚，景深随空间距离自然变化，材料纹理来自实物。不新增无依据的花叶或配件；文案仅按本条明确提供的内容渲染，不新增功能徽章或水印，商品已有真实标识按原样保留。

【展示数量】
多处摆放前确认是同场同时陈列还是独立替代用途图，逐载体绑定实际商品、颜色与分配数量。一包同时分装不能超出确认包数；额外包数或分别售卖商品须明确展示决定与购买含义。不自动混色，也不在每个载体复制整包。

【输出规格】
用户明确指定的画布与格式优先；未指定时输出一张 1464×600 px 的 sRGB PNG 完成图。把本条各区适配进画布，商品与所有必要标注完整入画；除本条明确要求的拼版外，不添加前后对比、设计说明或额外边框。该尺寸是桌面A+制作默认，不代表任何账户模块已核验接受；已确认的实际上传槽规格优先。

【字体与保护区】
单图全部文字、数字和单位使用同一可读字族，以字号、字重、字距和协调配色建立层级；展示字只在清楚可读时使用。保留本条指定的标题条、斜切底板、外框或彩色页脚，不固定棕白或黑字。文字、填充框、长笔画及字效避开完整商品加缓冲。明确无字或仅原生字段的选择优先；prompt中的字体名不证明已加载字体。

【输出目标】
生成一张真实商业商品摄影成图。

【目标环境】
目标画面为住宅后侧大窗旁的浅木台面，白色窗框、窗外柔化树木与近处米色窗帘形成完整环境。窗位于商品侧后方，台面前缘清楚，室内墙面保留柔和反射光，玻璃与窗外亮部仍有可辨层次。

【构图与取景】
完整商品以画布高约三分之二至四分之三为取景目标，并留安全边距。先确定有依据的商品与载体/家具相对尺寸，再调整机位或留白；冲突时放宽占比，不能独立拉伸商品部件。墙、窗和家具从属，焦点覆盖商品和支撑，远景渐柔。

【输入用途】

【背景替换】
输入商品照中的白底、原环境和棚拍影均不作为成品背景；提取商品后，直接生成下述完整环境并重新布光，不是在白底上仅调整曝光。

【摆放与受力】
按商品真实结构处理支撑：带挂钩或悬挂链的吊篮，使用其原挂件接到环境中的可信固定点，挂钩与链条连续受力，篮底下方留空气，不放在台面或地上，也不画篮底椭圆落地影；落地或台面款保持盆底贴合真实支撑面。不为套用环境给落地款新增挂链或更换随货盆。

【本款重点】
将实际商品放在住宅后侧窗旁，受控逆光加柔和正面补光，正面、整盆和台面接触可读。叶缘光符合材料，不把不透明仿真材变透，不画光晕。

【完成检查】
商品是第一视觉重心，建筑透视、挂点或接触、主光与投影属于同一真实空间。

成图为真实商业摄影：商品与近处承托或挂点清楚，景深随空间距离自然变化，材料纹理来自实物。不新增无依据的花叶或配件；文案仅按本条明确提供的内容渲染，不新增功能徽章或水印，商品已有真实标识按原样保留。

多处摆放前确认是同场同时陈列还是独立替代用途图，逐载体绑定实际商品、颜色与分配数量。一包同时分装不能超出确认包数；额外包数或分别售卖商品须明确展示决定与购买含义。不自动混色，也不在每个载体复制整包。

用户明确指定的画布与格式优先；未指定时输出一张 1600×1600 px 的 sRGB PNG 完成图。把本条各区适配进画布，商品与所有必要标注完整入画；除本条明确要求的拼版外，不添加前后对比、设计说明或额外边框。

Apply the task below only to parts, views and states supported for this actual SKU. Confirm necessary dimensions, materials, quantity and sale contents from SKU-specific records or the user; photos support only clearly visible appearance, not guessed measurements or material composition. A material name does not authorize unseen fibers, veins, seams, pores, gloss or hidden construction. Use details only where the actual source resolves them; sharpening, relighting or upscaling must not manufacture detail. If an indispensable fact, view or texture is missing or contradictory, ask the user for that specific input and wait before this dependent image. Request a clear same-product photo when needed. Do not infer an answer from templates, competitors, generated images or silence. Omit an optional unsupported claim; obtain a choice before changing a required view, panel count or information task. Design delegation covers styling, not product facts. New backgrounds and non-included props may follow the authorized design, but must not change merchandise identity or scale.

Create a complete white-background product image from a modest elevated viewpoint, showing the upper spread, actual container opening and front wall together. Use a viewpoint supported by the supplied product views. Keep rim perspective continuous with correct front-rim occlusion and the container's real height. Broad front-side soft light reveals top surfaces while gentle fill retains the inner rim and front wall. Include the entire outline on white without props. If the required upper surface is unsupported, request the corresponding product view before generating.

Use actual same-SKU photos for visible merchandise identity: resolved shape, color, connections and surface appearance. Establish material composition and sale contents separately from SKU records or user confirmation; a photographed container is not automatically included. Preserve supported internal composition and proportions within each instance while allowing the specified framing, lighting and placement.

Use pure RGB 255/255/255 white, including authentic openings between fine parts. Center the complete real silhouette with balanced modest clearance, retaining outer tips, stem ends and included base without adding material, stretching or cropping to fill the frame.

For hanging merchandise, show the full genuine hook and chains, keep the basket suspended, and add no horizon, tabletop or floor-contact ellipse. Only genuinely grounded products receive a narrow light contact shadow.

Retain crisp complete outlines and fine parts on even white without props, copy or dimension lines.

Render as photorealistic commercial photography with readable merchandise and immediate support, physically coherent depth of field and source-supported material texture. Add no unsupported foliage or accessories. Render only explicitly supplied copy and add no feature badges or watermark. Preserve genuine existing product marks.

Follow explicit user canvas and format instructions first. Otherwise return one finished sRGB PNG at 1600 by 1600 px. Fit the prescribed regions into this canvas with the required product outline and annotations intact. Add no before-and-after comparison, design explanation or extra frame unless this task explicitly requires it.

cards.promptZh:
【产品事实前置条件】
以下任务只适用于本SKU已有依据的部位、视角与状态。必要尺寸、材质、件数和随货范围来自对应SKU资料或用户确认；照片只支持清楚可辨的外观，不能猜测实测值或材质成分。材料名称不授权补造看不清的纤维、叶脉、接缝、孔隙、光泽或内部结构；锐化、重布光和放大不能制造商品细节。必要事实、视角或纹理缺失或冲突时，先询问具体缺项，收到回答前暂停本张依赖图；需要时请求同款清晰实拍。不从模板、竞品、生成图或沉默推导答案。非必要且无依据的卖点可省略；更换必要视角、减少已选窗口或改变信息任务须先取得选择。设计委托不等于事实确认；可按授权设计背景和非随货道具，但不能改变商品身份或尺寸。

【输出目标与布局】
制作轻俯视的完整白底商品图，画面同时读到上部展开、真实容器上口和前侧盆身。选择当前照片能够支持的略高视点，保持盆口透视连续，前口沿正确遮挡内部；盆身保留实际高度，不压扁成顶面俯拍。宽柔光从前侧照清上表面，适量补光保留口沿内侧与前壁层次。全部商品外缘入画，纯白背景无道具；若所需顶面没有素材依据，先索取对应视角照片。

【背景与取景】
背景为纯白 RGB 255/255/255，包括细枝与花叶间的真实空隙。完整商品居中，最外侧轮廓、实际杆端与随货底座完整入画，围绕真实轮廓留均衡窄边距，不能通过增花、拉伸或裁断来填满画面。

【输入用途】
同款实拍提供清楚可辨的形状、颜色、连接及表面外观。材质成分与随货范围另据对应SKU资料或用户确认，照片中的容器不自动视为随货。保留有依据的内部组成与比例；按本条规格调整取景、布光和摆放。

【支撑与阴影】
悬挂商品完整展示原挂钩与链条，篮底保持悬空，不生成地平线、台面或篮底落地影；有真实底座的落地商品仅保留窄而轻的接触影。

【完成检查】
完整外轮廓与细枝清楚，背景洁白均匀，无场景道具、文字和尺寸线。

【商品保真】
成图为真实商业摄影：商品与近处承托或挂点清楚，景深随空间距离自然变化，材料纹理来自实物。不新增无依据的花叶或配件；文案仅按本条明确提供的内容渲染，不新增功能徽章或水印，商品已有真实标识按原样保留。

【输出规格】
用户明确指定的画布与格式优先；未指定时输出一张 1600×1600 px 的 sRGB PNG 完成图。把本条各区适配进画布，商品与所有必要标注完整入画；除本条明确要求的拼版外，不添加前后对比、设计说明或额外边框。
requiredInputs: 自己的商品照片；局部看不清时才补该商品近拍。

cards.promptZh:
【产品事实前置条件】
以下任务只适用于本SKU已有依据的部位、视角与状态。必要尺寸、材质、件数和随货范围来自对应SKU资料或用户确认；照片只支持清楚可辨的外观，不能猜测实测值或材质成分。材料名称不授权补造看不清的纤维、叶脉、接缝、孔隙、光泽或内部结构；锐化、重布光和放大不能制造商品细节。必要事实、视角或纹理缺失或冲突时，先询问具体缺项，收到回答前暂停本张依赖图；需要时请求同款清晰实拍。不从模板、竞品、生成图或沉默推导答案。非必要且无依据的卖点可省略；更换必要视角、减少已选窗口或改变信息任务须先取得选择。设计委托不等于事实确认；可按授权设计背景和非随货道具，但不能改变商品身份或尺寸。

【输出目标与布局】
制作一张完整商品的纯白背景展示图。以真实商品的整体视觉重心居中取景，最上端、最宽外缘和随货底部均完整入画，四周留连续白色余量。用宽柔光照清前后层次和容器体积，焦点覆盖商品，不以虚化掩盖细部。背景及真实镂空均为纯白；有底座的摆放商品仅在实际接触处留克制软影，悬挂商品不出现地面与落地影。画面只展示真实售卖单位，无场景道具与图文。

【背景与取景】
背景为纯白 RGB 255/255/255，包括细枝与花叶间的真实空隙。完整商品居中，最外侧轮廓、实际杆端与随货底座完整入画，围绕真实轮廓留均衡窄边距，不能通过增花、拉伸或裁断来填满画面。

【输入用途】
同款实拍提供清楚可辨的形状、颜色、连接及表面外观。材质成分与随货范围另据对应SKU资料或用户确认，照片中的容器不自动视为随货。保留有依据的内部组成与比例；按本条规格调整取景、布光和摆放。

【支撑与阴影】
悬挂商品完整展示原挂钩与链条，篮底保持悬空，不生成地平线、台面或篮底落地影；有真实底座的落地商品仅保留窄而轻的接触影。

【完成检查】
完整外轮廓与细枝清楚，背景洁白均匀，无场景道具、文字和尺寸线。

【商品保真】
成图为真实商业摄影：商品与近处承托或挂点清楚，景深随空间距离自然变化，材料纹理来自实物。不新增无依据的花叶或配件；文案仅按本条明确提供的内容渲染，不新增功能徽章或水印，商品已有真实标识按原样保留。

【输出规格】
用户明确指定的画布与格式优先；未指定时输出一张 1600×1600 px 的 sRGB PNG 完成图。把本条各区适配进画布，商品与所有必要标注完整入画；除本条明确要求的拼版外，不添加前后对比、设计说明或额外边框。
requiredInputs: 自己的商品照片；局部看不清时才补该商品近拍。

cards.promptZh:
【产品事实前置条件】
以下任务只适用于本SKU已有依据的部位、视角与状态。必要尺寸、材质、件数和随货范围来自对应SKU资料或用户确认；照片只支持清楚可辨的外观，不能猜测实测值或材质成分。材料名称不授权补造看不清的纤维、叶脉、接缝、孔隙、光泽或内部结构；锐化、重布光和放大不能制造商品细节。必要事实、视角或纹理缺失或冲突时，先询问具体缺项，收到回答前暂停本张依赖图；需要时请求同款清晰实拍。不从模板、竞品、生成图或沉默推导答案。非必要且无依据的卖点可省略；更换必要视角、减少已选窗口或改变信息任务须先取得选择。设计委托不等于事实确认；可按授权设计背景和非随货道具，但不能改变商品身份或尺寸。

【输出目标】
生成一张真实商业商品摄影成图。

【目标环境】
搭建晴天住宅庭院与木门廊边缘，前景为浅色石板或台阶承托面，后方是暖木栏杆、草坪和柔和花园绿植。背景由亮绿与深绿层次组成，日照在石面和商品上形成统一方向的明暗。

【构图与取景】
以单个实际商品作中央近景，真实花冠大占比展开，完整容器和接触地面位于下方。取景保留右后方栏杆和两侧少量草坪，近处商品锐利，花园背景柔化，商品边缘无硬抠痕迹。

【输入用途】
同款实拍提供清楚可辨的形状、颜色、连接及表面外观。材质成分与随货范围另据对应SKU资料或用户确认，照片中的容器不自动视为随货。保留有依据的内部组成与比例；按本条规格调整取景、布光和摆放。

【背景替换】
输入商品照中的白底、原环境和棚拍影均不作为成品背景；提取商品后，直接生成下述完整环境并重新布光，不是在白底上仅调整曝光。

【摆放与受力】
按商品真实结构处理支撑：带挂钩或悬挂链的吊篮，使用其原挂件接到环境中的可信固定点，挂钩与链条连续受力，篮底下方留空气，不放在台面或地上，也不画篮底椭圆落地影；落地或台面款保持盆底贴合真实支撑面。不为套用环境给落地款新增挂链或更换随货盆。

【本款重点】
按本条规定的门廊或台阶布局制作商品场景，建筑、承托面和商品共同形成前中后景。商品摆位遵循此条构图，完整轮廓与各自真实承托关系清楚，近远变化来自场景透视。门柱、台阶和栏杆的延伸方向与商品视点一致，环境细节保持从属。按指定自然光统一主体明暗、接触影与建筑投影，将上载白底完整替换为有深度的住宅环境。

【完成检查】
商品是第一视觉重心，建筑透视、挂点或接触、主光与投影属于同一真实空间。

【商品保真】
成图为真实商业摄影：商品与近处承托或挂点清楚，景深随空间距离自然变化，材料纹理来自实物。不新增无依据的花叶或配件；文案仅按本条明确提供的内容渲染，不新增功能徽章或水印，商品已有真实标识按原样保留。

【展示数量】
多处摆放前确认是同场同时陈列还是独立替代用途图，逐载体绑定实际商品、颜色与分配数量。一包同时分装不能超出确认包数；额外包数或分别售卖商品须明确展示决定与购买含义。不自动混色，也不在每个载体复制整包。

【输出规格】
用户明确指定的画布与格式优先；未指定时输出一张 1600×1600 px 的 sRGB PNG 完成图。把本条各区适配进画布，商品与所有必要标注完整入画；除本条明确要求的拼版外，不添加前后对比、设计说明或额外边框。
requiredInputs: 自己的商品照片；局部看不清时才补该商品近拍。

cards.prompt:
PRODUCT-EVIDENCE PRECONDITIONS
Apply the task below only to parts, views and states supported for this actual SKU. Confirm necessary dimensions, materials, quantity and sale contents from SKU-specific records or the user; photos support only clearly visible appearance, not guessed measurements or material composition. A material name does not authorize unseen fibers, veins, seams, pores, gloss or hidden construction. Use details only where the actual source resolves them; sharpening, relighting or upscaling must not manufacture detail. If an indispensable fact, view or texture is missing or contradictory, ask the user for that specific input and wait before this dependent image. Request a clear same-product photo when needed. Do not infer an answer from templates, competitors, generated images or silence. Omit an optional unsupported claim; obtain a choice before changing a required view, panel count or information task. Design delegation covers styling, not product facts. New backgrounds and non-included props may follow the authorized design, but must not change merchandise identity or scale.

Create one photorealistic commercial product image.

Build a bright living-room window corner with a pale sofa and small round table at left, tall window and wood cabinet at right, beige wall and pale wood floor. Keep continuous diagonal window light across surfaces.

Place the complete actual product near center right by the window, with safe top and base margins. Use sofa and window-cabinet edges to frame the space, with a partial foreground table and readable room context.

Use actual same-SKU photos for visible merchandise identity: resolved shape, color, connections and surface appearance. Establish material composition and sale contents separately from SKU records or user confirmation; a photographed container is not automatically included. Preserve supported internal composition and proportions within each instance while allowing the specified framing, lighting and placement.

The input white backdrop, original surroundings and studio shadow are not the output setting. Extract the product, build the complete environment specified below and relight it, rather than merely adjusting exposure on white.

Resolve support from the actual merchandise. Suspend a basket with genuine hook or chains from a plausible environmental fixing, keeping its original load path continuous and air below the base, with no tabletop placement or elliptical floor-contact shadow. Ground a floor or tabletop product on a real support. Do not add chains to a floor product or replace an included container to fit the setting.

Create an interior product scene emphasizing lateral natural window light. Place the complete product as specified, keeping light direction consistent across its surfaces, container, wall and floor. Use soft bright illumination on the source side and environmental fill on the shaded side. Show window-bar shadows only where window and receiving-plane geometry support them, rather than stamping stripes on the product. Retain interior scale and depth, accurate color and readable detail, replacing the source white with the prescribed setting.

Make the merchandise the primary focal point with perspective, support and shadows belonging to one physical space.

Render as photorealistic commercial photography with readable merchandise and immediate support, physically coherent depth of field and source-supported material texture. Add no unsupported foliage or accessories. Render only explicitly supplied copy and add no feature badges or watermark. Preserve genuine existing product marks.

Before multiple placements, confirm whether they are simultaneous arrangements or separate alternative-use views. Map each actual product/color and allocated quantity to its container. For a simultaneous one-pack display, allocations must not exceed the confirmed pack contents; additional packs or separately sold products need an explicit display decision and clear purchase meaning. Do not clone a full pack into every container or mix variants by default.

Follow explicit user canvas and format instructions first. Otherwise return one finished sRGB PNG at 1600 by 1600 px. Fit the prescribed regions into this canvas with the required product outline and annotations intact. Add no before-and-after comparison, design explanation or extra frame unless this task explicitly requires it.

cards.promptZh:
【产品事实前置条件】
以下任务只适用于本SKU已有依据的部位、视角与状态。必要尺寸、材质、件数和随货范围来自对应SKU资料或用户确认；照片只支持清楚可辨的外观，不能猜测实测值或材质成分。材料名称不授权补造看不清的纤维、叶脉、接缝、孔隙、光泽或内部结构；锐化、重布光和放大不能制造商品细节。必要事实、视角或纹理缺失或冲突时，先询问具体缺项，收到回答前暂停本张依赖图；需要时请求同款清晰实拍。不从模板、竞品、生成图或沉默推导答案。非必要且无依据的卖点可省略；更换必要视角、减少已选窗口或改变信息任务须先取得选择。设计委托不等于事实确认；可按授权设计背景和非随货道具，但不能改变商品身份或尺寸。

【输出目标与布局】
制作已确认悬挂套装的白底错位陈列图。按真实售卖件数及本条对角方向排列，同规格商品保持一致缩放；每件从最高挂钩到篮底、垂枝完整，链路各自连接对应篮口。两件或多件之间留白，避免挂钩、链条与花冠交叠粘连，位置错落不改变实际大小。使用同向柔光，商品自然悬空，无地面与落地影。套装件数未确认时先询问，不擅自退回单件或复制参考数量。

【背景与取景】
背景为纯白 RGB 255/255/255，包括细枝与花叶间的真实空隙。完整商品居中，最外侧轮廓、实际杆端与随货底座完整入画，围绕真实轮廓留均衡窄边距，不能通过增花、拉伸或裁断来填满画面。

【输入用途】
同款实拍提供清楚可辨的形状、颜色、连接及表面外观。材质成分与随货范围另据对应SKU资料或用户确认，照片中的容器不自动视为随货。保留有依据的内部组成与比例；按本条规格调整取景、布光和摆放。

【支撑与阴影】
悬挂商品完整展示原挂钩与链条，篮底保持悬空，不生成地平线、台面或篮底落地影；有真实底座的落地商品仅保留窄而轻的接触影。

【本款构图细节】
确认双件时采用左上、右下的对角布局，篮体轻错开且各自挂链完整；两件间保留白色斜向沟槽，不让花冠与挂钩粘连。

【完成检查】
计件区同规格物件同尺度、轮廓分开；代表性放大视图另区展示，不额外计件。

【商品保真】
成图为真实商业摄影：商品与近处承托或挂点清楚，景深随空间距离自然变化，材料纹理来自实物。不新增无依据的花叶或配件；文案仅按本条明确提供的内容渲染，不新增功能徽章或水印，商品已有真实标识按原样保留。

【输出规格】
用户明确指定的画布与格式优先；未指定时输出一张 1600×1600 px 的 sRGB PNG 完成图。把本条各区适配进画布，商品与所有必要标注完整入画；除本条明确要求的拼版外，不添加前后对比、设计说明或额外边框。
requiredInputs: 自己的商品照片；局部看不清时才补该商品近拍。
包装图另需真实包装照片；套装图需确认实际随货组成与件数。

cards.prompt:
PRODUCT-EVIDENCE PRECONDITIONS
Apply the task below only to parts, views and states supported for this actual SKU. Confirm necessary dimensions, materials, quantity and sale contents from SKU-specific records or the user; photos support only clearly visible appearance, not guessed measurements or material composition. A material name does not authorize unseen fibers, veins, seams, pores, gloss or hidden construction. Use details only where the actual source resolves them; sharpening, relighting or upscaling must not manufacture detail. If an indispensable fact, view or texture is missing or contradictory, ask the user for that specific input and wait before this dependent image. Request a clear same-product photo when needed. Do not infer an answer from templates, competitors, generated images or silence. Omit an optional unsupported claim; obtain a choice before changing a required view, panel count or information task. Design delegation covers styling, not product facts. New backgrounds and non-included props may follow the authorized design, but must not change merchandise identity or scale.

Create a staggered white-background display of a confirmed hanging set. Use the actual sale quantity and prescribed diagonal direction, with equal scale for equal-size items. Keep each product complete from its highest hook through its own suspension paths to the base and trailing parts. Separate hooks, chains and crowns with white space; staggering must not change real size. Use matching soft light and natural suspension without a floor or ground shadow. Request an unconfirmed set quantity rather than silently switching to one item or copying the example count.

Use actual same-SKU photos for visible merchandise identity: resolved shape, color, connections and surface appearance. Establish material composition and sale contents separately from SKU records or user confirmation; a photographed container is not automatically included. Preserve supported internal composition and proportions within each instance while allowing the specified framing, lighting and placement.

Use pure RGB 255/255/255 white, including authentic openings between fine parts. Center the complete real silhouette with balanced modest clearance, retaining outer tips, stem ends and included base without adding material, stretching or cropping to fill the frame.

For hanging merchandise, show the full genuine hook and chains, keep the basket suspended, and add no horizon, tabletop or floor-contact ellipse. Only genuinely grounded products receive a narrow light contact shadow.

For a confirmed pair, use upper-left and lower-right placements at equal scale. Avoid major crown overlap and keep every real chain traceable to its own basket rim.

Use equal scale for equal-size inventory items, separate silhouettes and isolate magnified explanatory views from the sale count.

Render as photorealistic commercial photography with readable merchandise and immediate support, physically coherent depth of field and source-supported material texture. Add no unsupported foliage or accessories. Render only explicitly supplied copy and add no feature badges or watermark. Preserve genuine existing product marks.

Follow explicit user canvas and format instructions first. Otherwise return one finished sRGB PNG at 1600 by 1600 px. Fit the prescribed regions into this canvas with the required product outline and annotations intact. Add no before-and-after comparison, design explanation or extra frame unless this task explicitly requires it.

Create a staggered white-background display of a confirmed hanging set. Use the actual sale quantity and prescribed diagonal direction, with equal scale for equal-size items. Use actual same-SKU photos for visible merchandise identity: resolved shape, color, connections and surface appearance. Establish material composition and sale contents separately from SKU records or user confirmation; a photographed container is not automatically included. Use pure RGB 255/255/255 white, including authentic openings between fine parts. Center the complete real silhouette with balanced modest clearance, retaining outer tips, stem ends and included base without adding material, stretching or cropping to fill the frame.

This card uses lower-left and upper-right positions, reversing the other diagonal variants. For a confirmed pair, preserve equal scale, complete top hooks and lowest foliage, and white separation near the center.

Use equal scale for equal-size inventory items, separate silhouettes and isolate magnified explanatory views from the sale count.

cards.promptZh:
【产品事实前置条件】

【输出目标与布局】
制作已确认悬挂套装的白底错位陈列图。按真实售卖件数及本条对角方向排列，同规格商品保持一致缩放；每件从最高挂钩到篮底、垂枝完整，链路各自连接对应篮口。两件或多件之间留白，避免挂钩、链条与花冠交叠粘连，位置错落不改变实际大小。使用同向柔光，商品自然悬空，无地面与落地影。套装件数未确认时先询问，不擅自退回单件或复制参考数量。

【背景与取景】
背景为纯白 RGB 255/255/255，包括细枝与花叶间的真实空隙。完整商品居中，最外侧轮廓、实际杆端与随货底座完整入画，围绕真实轮廓留均衡窄边距，不能通过增花、拉伸或裁断来填满画面。

【输入用途】
同款实拍提供清楚可辨的形状、颜色、连接及表面外观。材质成分与随货范围另据对应SKU资料或用户确认，照片中的容器不自动视为随货。保留有依据的内部组成与比例；按本条规格调整取景、布光和摆放。

【支撑与阴影】
悬挂商品完整展示原挂钩与链条，篮底保持悬空，不生成地平线、台面或篮底落地影；有真实底座的落地商品仅保留窄而轻的接触影。

【本款构图细节】
本款对角方向为左下与右上，区别于左高右低的套装构图。确认双件后等比例分开放置，各自最高挂钩和最低花叶完整，画面中心保留透白间隙。

【完成检查】
计件区同规格物件同尺度、轮廓分开；代表性放大视图另区展示，不额外计件。

【商品保真】
成图为真实商业摄影：商品与近处承托或挂点清楚，景深随空间距离自然变化，材料纹理来自实物。不新增无依据的花叶或配件；文案仅按本条明确提供的内容渲染，不新增功能徽章或水印，商品已有真实标识按原样保留。

【输出规格】
用户明确指定的画布与格式优先；未指定时输出一张 1600×1600 px 的 sRGB PNG 完成图。把本条各区适配进画布，商品与所有必要标注完整入画；除本条明确要求的拼版外，不添加前后对比、设计说明或额外边框。

cards.prompt:
PRODUCT-EVIDENCE PRECONDITIONS
Apply the task below only to parts, views and states supported for this actual SKU. Confirm necessary dimensions, materials, quantity and sale contents from SKU-specific records or the user; photos support only clearly visible appearance, not guessed measurements or material composition. A material name does not authorize unseen fibers, veins, seams, pores, gloss or hidden construction. Use details only where the actual source resolves them; sharpening, relighting or upscaling must not manufacture detail. If an indispensable fact, view or texture is missing or contradictory, ask the user for that specific input and wait before this dependent image. Request a clear same-product photo when needed. Do not infer an answer from templates, competitors, generated images or silence. Omit an optional unsupported claim; obtain a choice before changing a required view, panel count or information task. Design delegation covers styling, not product facts. New backgrounds and non-included props may follow the authorized design, but must not change merchandise identity or scale.

Create one close-up of the actual product crown, using its real spread as the main visual mass. Focus clearly on the foreground region that best explains its layers while keeping rear shapes and soft occlusion shadows readable. Leave a little white clearance. Crop away stems or a base outside this detail's scope, keeping important centers and the explained joint away from crop edges. Use soft front-side light for real overlaps and surface form. Do not add heads or invent a complete product; request a clear close-up when source detail is insufficient.

Use actual same-SKU photos for visible merchandise identity: resolved shape, color, connections and surface appearance. Establish material composition and sale contents separately from SKU records or user confirmation; a photographed container is not automatically included. Preserve supported internal composition and proportions within each instance while allowing the specified framing, lighting and placement.

Use a quiet white or pale-neutral photographic background and only the prescribed views and regions. Do not inherit input studio shadows or its page layout.

The source backdrop, old page layout and studio shadow are not merchandise identity. Build the explicitly prescribed colors, regions, views and windows without automatically adding cards, caption strips or props. When this task explicitly assigns residential usage, an operation step or a night scene, establish that environment only within its own photograph; retain the prescribed background elsewhere.

If the product has a hook and chains, retain them completely in the whole-product region and keep the basket base suspended. Do not place a hanging basket on a tabletop and add no base-contact shadow, ground or horizon. Detail circles crop genuine regions without repeating the entire suspension. Only a genuinely standing product receives a light shadow at its real base.

Match whole and close views with a broad upper-front-left key, weaker right fill and neutral white balance, retaining small genuine overlap shadows at petals, edges and connections. Do not place whole-product floor shadows behind close-ups; only a complete grounded product receives narrow actual-base contact. Each action photograph must retain coherent support and shadow direction.

Map every detail window to a distinct resolved region in an actual same-product photo; keep the explained joint intact and match exposure, balance and gutters. If a required region is absent or unresolved, request its close-up and wait, or obtain a choice of a supported replacement or fewer windows. Do not silently reduce the selected layout, repeat one crop as different evidence, or invent hidden interfaces or microscopic texture.

Render as photorealistic commercial photography with readable merchandise and immediate support, physically coherent depth of field and source-supported material texture. Add no unsupported foliage or accessories. Render only explicitly supplied copy and add no feature badges or watermark. Preserve genuine existing product marks.

Follow explicit user canvas and format instructions first. Otherwise return one finished sRGB PNG at 1600 by 1600 px. Fit the prescribed regions into this canvas with the required product outline and annotations intact. Add no before-and-after comparison, design explanation or extra frame unless this task explicitly requires it.

【输出目标】
生成一张真实商业商品摄影成图。

【目标环境】
搭建浅色窗边边桌场景，桌面为浅灰米色，后方是透光白纱帘。右侧有小台灯与浅色褶皱灯罩，左侧只露一小段叠书；商品下方为素色浅木托盘，整体光照柔和、明亮且材质细节自然。

【构图与取景】
单个实际商品位于中央，完整花冠和真实容器构成焦点，容器置于桌面托盘范围内。灯位于右后、书位于左下，彼此不遮挡商品；商品正面与容器清楚，纱帘背景温和虚化。

【摆放与受力】
按商品真实结构处理支撑：带挂钩或悬挂链的吊篮，使用其原挂件接到环境中的可信固定点，挂钩与链条连续受力，篮底下方留空气，不放在台面或地上，也不画篮底椭圆落地影；落地或台面款保持盆底贴合真实支撑面。不为套用环境给落地款新增挂链或更换随货盆。

以下任务只适用于本SKU已有依据的部位、视角与状态。必要尺寸、材质、件数和随货范围来自对应SKU资料或用户确认；照片只支持清楚可辨的外观，不能猜测实测值或材质成分。材料名称不授权补造看不清的纤维、叶脉、接缝、孔隙、光泽或内部结构；锐化、重布光和放大不能制造商品细节。必要事实、视角或纹理缺失或冲突时，先询问具体缺项，收到回答前暂停本张依赖图；需要时请求同款清晰实拍。不从模板、竞品、生成图或沉默推导答案。非必要且无依据的卖点可省略；更换必要视角、减少已选窗口或改变信息任务须先取得选择。设计委托不等于事实确认；可按授权设计背景和非随货道具，但不能改变商品身份或尺寸。

【输出目标与布局】
生成白底开盒总览与单件结构图。实际开盒包装占左上主区，以轻俯视展示真实盒盖、盒沿与内容排列；右侧及下方以独立小区域展示同款单件正面、侧面或带杆状态，按已有素材选择，不虚构可拆接点。白色间隔明确区分包装内容与说明视图；包装、数量及每种状态均由用户提供依据，缺失先询问。柔光一致，不加文案，不把盒外特写计为额外随货。

【背景】
使用低对比的白色或浅中性摄影背景，画面只保留本款规定的视图与分区；不要沿用输入照片的棚拍影或原版布局。

【输入用途】
同款实拍提供清楚可辨的形状、颜色、连接及表面外观。材质成分与随货范围另据对应SKU资料或用户确认，照片中的容器不自动视为随货。保留有依据的内部组成与比例；按本条规格调整取景、布光和摆放。

【版面与主体分离】
素材背景、旧排版与旧棚拍影不是商品身份。按本条明确规定的底色、分区、视图和窗口建立版面；没有指定的卡片、说明条或道具不自动添加。住宅使用、操作步骤或夜景若在本条中明确指定，只在对应照片区域内建立其环境；其他区域保留本条指定背景。

【全貌区支撑】
若商品含挂钩和链条，全貌区必须完整保留原挂钩与链条，让篮底悬空展示：不把吊篮放在台面上，不画篮底接触影、地面或地平线。局部圆窗只裁取真实部位，无须重复整个悬挂结构。实际落地商品才在真实底座处保留轻微接触影。

【分区布光】
各全貌与近拍采用一致的左前上方宽柔主光、较弱右侧补光与中性白平衡；瓣层、叶缘和真实连接的微小遮挡影保留。近拍背景不画全商品落地影，只有完整落地商品在实际底座保留窄接触影；步骤照片各自保持受力与影向合理。

【完成检查】
每个窗口绑定同款实拍中不同且清晰的部位，接点完整，曝光、白平衡和间距一致。必要部位缺失或不清楚时先请求对应近拍，或询问改用已有依据的部位/减少窗口；未获选择不静默减窗，不把同一裁切重复当不同证据，不补造接口或微观纹理。

【商品保真】
成图为真实商业摄影：商品与近处承托或挂点清楚，景深随空间距离自然变化，材料纹理来自实物。不新增无依据的花叶或配件；文案仅按本条明确提供的内容渲染，不新增功能徽章或水印，商品已有真实标识按原样保留。

【输出规格】
用户明确指定的画布与格式优先；未指定时输出一张 1600×1600 px 的 sRGB PNG 完成图。把本条各区适配进画布，商品与所有必要标注完整入画；除本条明确要求的拼版外，不添加前后对比、设计说明或额外边框。
requiredInputs: 自己的商品照片；局部看不清时才补该商品近拍。

cards.prompt:
PRODUCT-EVIDENCE PRECONDITIONS
Apply the task below only to parts, views and states supported for this actual SKU. Confirm necessary dimensions, materials, quantity and sale contents from SKU-specific records or the user; photos support only clearly visible appearance, not guessed measurements or material composition. A material name does not authorize unseen fibers, veins, seams, pores, gloss or hidden construction. Use details only where the actual source resolves them; sharpening, relighting or upscaling must not manufacture detail. If an indispensable fact, view or texture is missing or contradictory, ask the user for that specific input and wait before this dependent image. Request a clear same-product photo when needed. Do not infer an answer from templates, competitors, generated images or silence. Omit an optional unsupported claim; obtain a choice before changing a required view, panel count or information task. Design delegation covers styling, not product facts. New backgrounds and non-included props may follow the authorized design, but must not change merchandise identity or scale.

Create a white-background product image with accurate color and readable structure inside saturated regions. Follow the actual product for composition and cropping. Preserve the original hue, small highlight variations and visible centers, veins or joints in darker areas. Use controlled soft light and neutral white balance without clipping dense colors into flat patches. Keep the background pure white and separate front and rear surfaces through genuine occlusion and soft shading. Do not transfer example colors or substitute a global saturation boost for material detail.

Use actual same-SKU photos for visible merchandise identity: resolved shape, color, connections and surface appearance. Establish material composition and sale contents separately from SKU records or user confirmation; a photographed container is not automatically included. Preserve supported internal composition and proportions within each instance while allowing the specified framing, lighting and placement.

Use pure RGB 255/255/255 white, including authentic openings between fine parts. Center the complete real silhouette with balanced modest clearance, retaining outer tips, stem ends and included base without adding material, stretching or cropping to fill the frame.

For hanging merchandise, show the full genuine hook and chains, keep the basket suspended, and add no horizon, tabletop or floor-contact ellipse. Only genuinely grounded products receive a narrow light contact shadow.

Retain crisp complete outlines and fine parts on even white without props, copy or dimension lines.

Render as photorealistic commercial photography with readable merchandise and immediate support, physically coherent depth of field and source-supported material texture. Add no unsupported foliage or accessories. Render only explicitly supplied copy and add no feature badges or watermark. Preserve genuine existing product marks.

Follow explicit user canvas and format instructions first. Otherwise return one finished sRGB PNG at 1600 by 1600 px. Fit the prescribed regions into this canvas with the required product outline and annotations intact. Add no before-and-after comparison, design explanation or extra frame unless this task explicitly requires it.

【输出目标与布局】
制作实际商品冠部的单幅近景，以真实花叶展开形成主要视觉块。将最能说明层次的前部区域作为清晰焦点，后层保留可辨形态和柔和遮挡影，外围留少量白色呼吸空间。允许裁去本图不展示的杆部与底部，但裁边避开关键花心和所讲连接。用柔和侧前光呈现真实叠层与表面起伏，不增加花头或凭空补全商品；原图细节不足时先索取清晰近照。

【背景】

cards.promptZh:
【产品事实前置条件】
以下任务只适用于本SKU已有依据的部位、视角与状态。必要尺寸、材质、件数和随货范围来自对应SKU资料或用户确认；照片只支持清楚可辨的外观，不能猜测实测值或材质成分。材料名称不授权补造看不清的纤维、叶脉、接缝、孔隙、光泽或内部结构；锐化、重布光和放大不能制造商品细节。必要事实、视角或纹理缺失或冲突时，先询问具体缺项，收到回答前暂停本张依赖图；需要时请求同款清晰实拍。不从模板、竞品、生成图或沉默推导答案。非必要且无依据的卖点可省略；更换必要视角、减少已选窗口或改变信息任务须先取得选择。设计委托不等于事实确认；可按授权设计背景和非随货道具，但不能改变商品身份或尺寸。

【输出目标与布局】
生成无字 A+ 全貌与使用场景的主辅拼版。白底完整商品居左约65%；右侧约35%为独立住宅使用图，商品放在浅墙侧窗旁，以真实地面、台面或挂点承托，具体方式服从实物结构。左右以窄白沟槽分开，主视图完整保留最高端、杆端和真实底座，右图不压住主图。两区同款同色，各自透视和光影成立；右图表示用途，不表示额外随货。无标题、尺寸线、图标或功能徽章。

【输入用途】
同款实拍提供清楚可辨的形状、颜色、连接及表面外观。材质成分与随货范围另据对应SKU资料或用户确认，照片中的容器不自动视为随货。保留有依据的内部组成与比例；按本条规格调整取景、布光和摆放。

【版面与主体分离】
白底只属于左侧全貌区，右侧住宅使用图保留真实空间与受力关系；两区使用同一实际商品，各自光照合理，以白色沟槽清楚分开。

【全貌区支撑】
若商品含挂钩和链条，全貌区必须完整保留原挂钩与链条，让篮底悬空展示：不把吊篮放在台面上，不画篮底接触影、地面或地平线。局部圆窗只裁取真实部位，无须重复整个悬挂结构。实际落地商品才在真实底座处保留轻微接触影。

【分区布光】
住宅区主光来自画面左上方的实际侧窗，右侧弱反射补光保留原色，投影背离窗体；独立白底视图用同方向中性柔光。各自接触影只落在真实承影面，悬挂底部不画落地影。

【完成检查】
保留本款横幅或拼版的阅读顺序，重要商品部位与文字位于裁切安全区；使用本条画布，实际账户上传槽另行核对。

【商品保真】
成图为真实商业摄影：商品与近处承托或挂点清楚，景深随空间距离自然变化，材料纹理来自实物。不新增无依据的花叶或配件；文案仅按本条明确提供的内容渲染，不新增功能徽章或水印，商品已有真实标识按原样保留。

【输出规格】
用户明确指定的画布与格式优先；未指定时输出一张 1464×600 px 的 sRGB PNG 完成图。把本条各区适配进画布，商品与所有必要标注完整入画；除本条明确要求的拼版外，不添加前后对比、设计说明或额外边框。该尺寸是桌面A+制作默认，不代表任何账户模块已核验接受；已确认的实际上传槽规格优先。
requiredInputs: 自己的商品照片；局部看不清时才补该商品近拍。

Use details only where the actual source resolves them; sharpening, relighting or upscaling must not manufacture detail. Request a missing sale list before generating instead of cloning items to match the example count.

Use actual same-SKU photos for visible merchandise identity: resolved shape, color, connections and surface appearance. Establish material composition and sale contents separately from SKU records or user confirmation; a photographed container is not automatically included. Follow explicit user canvas and format instructions first. Otherwise return one finished sRGB PNG at 1600 by 1600 px. cards.referenceGroup: 单场景与控制器小窗 · 真实状态展示
cards.promptZh:
【产品事实前置条件】
以下任务只适用于本SKU已有依据的部位、视角与状态。必要尺寸、材质、件数和随货范围来自对应SKU资料或用户确认；照片只支持清楚可辨的外观，不能猜测实测值或材质成分。材料名称不授权补造看不清的纤维、叶脉、接缝、孔隙、光泽或内部结构；锐化、重布光和放大不能制造商品细节。必要事实、视角或纹理缺失或冲突时，先询问具体缺项，收到回答前暂停本张依赖图；需要时请求同款清晰实拍。不从模板、竞品、生成图或沉默推导答案。非必要且无依据的卖点可省略；更换必要视角、减少已选窗口或改变信息任务须先取得选择。设计委托不等于事实确认；可按授权设计背景和非随货道具，但不能改变商品身份或尺寸。

【输出目标与布局】
生成单幅住宅室内商品场景，完整商品占主区，浅墙、窗帘和少量家具交代空间。仅在用户提供随货控制器真实照片并确认关联时，在右上设置独立小型控制器视窗；没有控制器依据则去掉小窗。只有已确认点亮状态才呈现原有灯色，不生成左右模式对照，不加无线波纹、旋转箭头或虚构功能。全貌与小窗留白分隔，曝光自然，无字。

【输入用途】
同款实拍提供清楚可辨的形状、颜色、连接及表面外观。材质成分与随货范围另据对应SKU资料或用户确认，照片中的容器不自动视为随货。保留有依据的内部组成与比例；按本条规格调整取景、布光和摆放。

【版面与主体分离】
主区为完整住宅场景：浅墙、左侧侧窗与少量家具形成纵深，右上配件窗采用独立白底；不要把整幅换成白色棚拍底。场景中商品的受光与接触/挂接统一，小窗只展示真实配件。

【全貌区支撑】
若商品含挂钩和链条，全貌区必须完整保留原挂钩与链条，让篮底悬空展示：不把吊篮放在台面上，不画篮底接触影、地面或地平线。局部圆窗只裁取真实部位，无须重复整个悬挂结构。实际落地商品才在真实底座处保留轻微接触影。

【分区布光】
住宅区主光来自画面左上方的实际侧窗，右侧弱反射补光保留原色，投影背离窗体；独立白底视图用同方向中性柔光。各自接触影只落在真实承影面，悬挂底部不画落地影。

【完成检查】
全貌负责识别；若含近拍则解释对应真实细节。文字紧邻对应区域，标题、正文和标签层级清楚。

【商品保真】
成图为真实商业摄影：商品与近处承托或挂点清楚，景深随空间距离自然变化，材料纹理来自实物。不新增无依据的花叶或配件；文案仅按本条明确提供的内容渲染，不新增功能徽章或水印，商品已有真实标识按原样保留。

【输出规格】
用户明确指定的画布与格式优先；未指定时输出一张 1600×1600 px 的 sRGB PNG 完成图。把本条各区适配进画布，商品与所有必要标注完整入画；除本条明确要求的拼版外，不添加前后对比、设计说明或额外边框。
requiredInputs: 自己的商品照片；局部看不清时才补该商品近拍。

cards.usage: 上传自己的商品照片，复制中文到 GPT Image 2 或 Lovart；目标背景与构图已写入正文，无需上传库内预览图。
cards.prompt:
PRODUCT-EVIDENCE PRECONDITIONS
Apply the task below only to parts, views and states supported for this actual SKU. Confirm necessary dimensions, materials, quantity and sale contents from SKU-specific records or the user; photos support only clearly visible appearance, not guessed measurements or material composition. A material name does not authorize unseen fibers, veins, seams, pores, gloss or hidden construction. Use details only where the actual source resolves them; sharpening, relighting or upscaling must not manufacture detail. If an indispensable fact, view or texture is missing or contradictory, ask the user for that specific input and wait before this dependent image. Request a clear same-product photo when needed. Do not infer an answer from templates, competitors, generated images or silence. Omit an optional unsupported claim; obtain a choice before changing a required view, panel count or information task. Design delegation covers styling, not product facts. New backgrounds and non-included props may follow the authorized design, but must not change merchandise identity or scale.

Create a pure-white photograph of the actual closed retail package. Present the principal printed face with modest side depth and top visibility, maintaining continuous perspective in edges, folds and closures. Keep the entire package visible with a restrained base contact shadow. Broad soft light preserves real paper, coating and film reflections. Retain existing artwork and print from source photography rather than regenerating missing content. Obtain a clear actual-package photo and confirm its closed state first; request missing evidence instead of designing packaging or substituting a bare-product image.

Use actual same-SKU photos for visible merchandise identity: resolved shape, color, connections and surface appearance. Establish material composition and sale contents separately from SKU records or user confirmation; a photographed container is not automatically included. Preserve supported internal composition and proportions within each instance while allowing the specified framing, lighting and placement.

Use a clean white or pale-neutral seamless background, showing the complete real package outline, principal printed face and a little depth.

Keep real lid, rim, folds and content occlusion consistent; preserve existing print and do not fabricate packaging facts.

Render as photorealistic commercial photography with readable merchandise and immediate support, physically coherent depth of field and source-supported material texture. Add no unsupported foliage or accessories. Render only explicitly supplied copy and add no feature badges or watermark. Preserve genuine existing product marks.

Follow explicit user canvas and format instructions first. Otherwise return one finished sRGB PNG at 1600 by 1600 px. Fit the prescribed regions into this canvas with the required product outline and annotations intact. Add no before-and-after comparison, design explanation or extra frame unless this task explicitly requires it.

cards.referenceGroup: 礼品陈列 · 包装边界
cards.promptZh:
【产品事实前置条件】
以下任务只适用于本SKU已有依据的部位、视角与状态。必要尺寸、材质、件数和随货范围来自对应SKU资料或用户确认；照片只支持清楚可辨的外观，不能猜测实测值或材质成分。材料名称不授权补造看不清的纤维、叶脉、接缝、孔隙、光泽或内部结构；锐化、重布光和放大不能制造商品细节。必要事实、视角或纹理缺失或冲突时，先询问具体缺项，收到回答前暂停本张依赖图；需要时请求同款清晰实拍。不从模板、竞品、生成图或沉默推导答案。非必要且无依据的卖点可省略；更换必要视角、减少已选窗口或改变信息任务须先取得选择。设计委托不等于事实确认；可按授权设计背景和非随货道具，但不能改变商品身份或尺寸。

【输出目标与布局】
制作商品真实礼品包装状态的完整白底图。按实际包装照片呈现容器、包裹、绑带和吊牌的层次，包口、布料折痕和边缘连接清楚，前后遮挡与真实装配一致。柔光照清不同材质，吊牌原有印刷尽量保留源图，完整外缘和底部入画。隐藏内容不被透视展开，包装图案不能变成实物花朵。先确认包装组件随货及实际外观；资料不足先索取，不凭印花推演生长状态或新增礼盒。

【背景与取景】
干净的白色或浅中性无缝背景，以实际包装为主体，完整展示盒型或真实包裹外轮廓，保留主要印刷面和少量侧深。

【输入用途】
同款实拍提供清楚可辨的形状、颜色、连接及表面外观。材质成分与随货范围另据对应SKU资料或用户确认，照片中的容器不自动视为随货。保留有依据的内部组成与比例；按本条规格调整取景、布光和摆放。

【完成检查】
盒盖、口沿、折面和内容遮挡符合真实包装，已有印刷保留原样，不生成缺失包装事实。

【商品保真】
成图为真实商业摄影：商品与近处承托或挂点清楚，景深随空间距离自然变化，材料纹理来自实物。不新增无依据的花叶或配件；文案仅按本条明确提供的内容渲染，不新增功能徽章或水印，商品已有真实标识按原样保留。

【输出规格】
用户明确指定的画布与格式优先；未指定时输出一张 1600×1600 px 的 sRGB PNG 完成图。把本条各区适配进画布，商品与所有必要标注完整入画；除本条明确要求的拼版外，不添加前后对比、设计说明或额外边框。
requiredInputs: 自己的商品照片；局部看不清时才补该商品近拍。
包装图另需真实包装照片；套装图需确认实际随货组成与件数。

cards.title: 独立散枝 · 网格间距
cards.description: 生成白底套装网格清单，只按确认随货组成和件数排成清楚行列，间距、图片尺度和光照统一。
cards.note: 按本条指定背景和布局生成，保留自己商品的内部组成与材质；缺少必要视角、事实或文案先补对应资料。
cards.usage: 上传自己的商品照片，复制中文到 GPT Image 2 或 Lovart；目标背景与构图已写入正文，无需上传库内预览图。
cards.prompt:
PRODUCT-EVIDENCE PRECONDITIONS
Apply the task below only to parts, views and states supported for this actual SKU. Confirm necessary dimensions, materials, quantity and sale contents from SKU-specific records or the user; photos support only clearly visible appearance, not guessed measurements or material composition. A material name does not authorize unseen fibers, veins, seams, pores, gloss or hidden construction. Use details only where the actual source resolves them; sharpening, relighting or upscaling must not manufacture detail. If an indispensable fact, view or texture is missing or contradictory, ask the user for that specific input and wait before this dependent image. Request a clear same-product photo when needed. Do not infer an answer from templates, competitors, generated images or silence. Omit an optional unsupported claim; obtain a choice before changing a required view, panel count or information task. Design delegation covers styling, not product facts. New backgrounds and non-included props may follow the authorized design, but must not change merchandise identity or scale.

Create a regular white-background inventory array. Confirm actual sale components and total quantity, then use the prescribed row, column or stagger direction. Match scale for matching sizes and keep heads, stem ends and outlines distinct. Align row baselines and spacing, balancing an incomplete final row with white space rather than cloning components to fill it. The array represents inventory only, without enlargements, usage images or decoration. Match neutral soft light and white balance. Request a missing sale list; never derive quantity from the example.

Use actual same-SKU photos for visible merchandise identity: resolved shape, color, connections and surface appearance. Establish material composition and sale contents separately from SKU records or user confirmation; a photographed container is not automatically included. Preserve supported internal composition and proportions within each instance while allowing the specified framing, lighting and placement.

Use pure RGB 255/255/255 white, including authentic openings between fine parts. Center the complete real silhouette with balanced modest clearance, retaining outer tips, stem ends and included base without adding material, stretching or cropping to fill the frame.

For hanging merchandise, show the full genuine hook and chains, keep the basket suspended, and add no horizon, tabletop or floor-contact ellipse. Only genuinely grounded products receive a narrow light contact shadow.

Arrange real stems in regular rows with distinct heads and tips, aligning ends to each row baseline. The matrix represents confirmed inventory only; do not clone stems to fill it or change berries or branches on each stem.

Use equal scale for equal-size inventory items, separate silhouettes and isolate magnified explanatory views from the sale count.

Render as photorealistic commercial photography with readable merchandise and immediate support, physically coherent depth of field and source-supported material texture. Add no unsupported foliage or accessories. Render only explicitly supplied copy and add no feature badges or watermark. Preserve genuine existing product marks.

Follow explicit user canvas and format instructions first. Otherwise return one finished sRGB PNG at 1600 by 1600 px. Fit the prescribed regions into this canvas with the required product outline and annotations intact. Add no before-and-after comparison, design explanation or extra frame unless this task explicitly requires it.

【输出目标与布局】
制作实际桌面组合的完整白底展示图。沿真实横向展开取景，上部装饰、底托、真实烛台或随货部件均完整且各自可辨，前后遮挡保持原有装配关系。用宽柔光照清细枝和深色支架，底部只留与承托相连的轻影。商品中的蜡烛或光源数量与状态以实际资料为准；要求点亮但没有依据时先确认。不得按参考新增蜡烛、火焰、灯线、装饰花叶或其他随货部件。

【背景与取景】
背景为纯白 RGB 255/255/255，包括细枝与花叶间的真实空隙。完整商品居中，最外侧轮廓、实际杆端与随货底座完整入画，围绕真实轮廓留均衡窄边距，不能通过增花、拉伸或裁断来填满画面。

【输入用途】
同款实拍提供清楚可辨的形状、颜色、连接及表面外观。材质成分与随货范围另据对应SKU资料或用户确认，照片中的容器不自动视为随货。保留有依据的内部组成与比例；按本条规格调整取景、布光和摆放。

【支撑与阴影】

完整外轮廓与细枝清楚，背景洁白均匀，无场景道具、文字和尺寸线。

成图为真实商业摄影：商品与近处承托或挂点清楚，景深随空间距离自然变化，材料纹理来自实物。不新增无依据的花叶或配件；文案仅按本条明确提供的内容渲染，不新增功能徽章或水印，商品已有真实标识按原样保留。

商品是第一视觉重心，建筑透视、挂点或接触、主光与投影属于同一真实空间。

多处摆放前确认是同场同时陈列还是独立替代用途图，逐载体绑定实际商品、颜色与分配数量。一包同时分装不能超出确认包数；额外包数或分别售卖商品须明确展示决定与购买含义。不自动混色，也不在每个载体复制整包。

【输出规格】
用户明确指定的画布与格式优先；未指定时输出一张 1600×1600 px 的 sRGB PNG 完成图。把本条各区适配进画布，商品与所有必要标注完整入画；除本条明确要求的拼版外，不添加前后对比、设计说明或额外边框。

cards.referenceGroup: 暗背景近景 · 光点与颜色
cards.promptZh:
【产品事实前置条件】
以下任务只适用于本SKU已有依据的部位、视角与状态。必要尺寸、材质、件数和随货范围来自对应SKU资料或用户确认；照片只支持清楚可辨的外观，不能猜测实测值或材质成分。材料名称不授权补造看不清的纤维、叶脉、接缝、孔隙、光泽或内部结构；锐化、重布光和放大不能制造商品细节。必要事实、视角或纹理缺失或冲突时，先询问具体缺项，收到回答前暂停本张依赖图；需要时请求同款清晰实拍。不从模板、竞品、生成图或沉默推导答案。非必要且无依据的卖点可省略；更换必要视角、减少已选窗口或改变信息任务须先取得选择。设计委托不等于事实确认；可按授权设计背景和非随货道具，但不能改变商品身份或尺寸。

【输出目标】
生成一张真实商业商品摄影成图。

【目标环境】
目标为夜间花坛中的发光商品近景，后方是暗绿叶片与深色土面，少量环境补光保留本体表面，已证实的发光处成为局部暖亮点。背景色调深而自然，不能改成浅色商品棚拍。

【构图与取景】
以实际商品上部的真实组合轮廓为近拍中心，旁侧叶片与杆部保留身份和连接线索，下部安装区可以在画外。亮芯、外缘与表面结构分层，高光不爆白，原部件数量与排列不因灯效改变。

【输入用途】
同款实拍提供清楚可辨的形状、颜色、连接及表面外观。材质成分与随货范围另据对应SKU资料或用户确认，照片中的容器不自动视为随货。保留有依据的内部组成与比例；按本条规格调整取景、布光和摆放。

【背景替换】
输入商品照中的白底、原环境和棚拍影均不作为成品背景；提取商品后，直接生成下述完整环境并重新布光，不是在白底上仅调整曝光。

【本款重点】
制作已确认点亮状态的单幅近景，重点呈现真实发光部位与相邻表面层次。选定主部位清晰入焦，周边保持足以解释实际连接的结构，后景低对比柔化。曝光同时保护发光区域的颜色与边缘，暗面用少量补光读清，不把花瓣、叶片或支架糊成无结构光团。发光颜色、位置和状态必须有当前商品依据，缺失先索取；不新增灯点、彩虹渐变、星芒或运动轨迹。

【完成检查】
每个窗口绑定同款实拍中不同且清晰的部位，接点完整，曝光、白平衡和间距一致。必要部位缺失或不清楚时先请求对应近拍，或询问改用已有依据的部位/减少窗口；未获选择不静默减窗，不把同一裁切重复当不同证据，不补造接口或微观纹理。

【商品保真】
成图为真实商业摄影：商品与近处承托或挂点清楚，景深随空间距离自然变化，材料纹理来自实物。不新增无依据的花叶或配件；文案仅按本条明确提供的内容渲染，不新增功能徽章或水印，商品已有真实标识按原样保留。

【展示数量】
多处摆放前确认是同场同时陈列还是独立替代用途图，逐载体绑定实际商品、颜色与分配数量。一包同时分装不能超出确认包数；额外包数或分别售卖商品须明确展示决定与购买含义。不自动混色，也不在每个载体复制整包。

【输出规格】
用户明确指定的画布与格式优先；未指定时输出一张 1600×1600 px 的 sRGB PNG 完成图。把本条各区适配进画布，商品与所有必要标注完整入画；除本条明确要求的拼版外，不添加前后对比、设计说明或额外边框。
requiredInputs: 自己的商品照片；局部看不清时才补该商品近拍。

cards.title: 放射点光 · 保留真实连接
cards.description: 在安静黄昏花园展示实际点光商品，发光点与暗支撑清楚分离，真实接点和空隙不变。
cards.note: 商品照提供商品身份；成品环境按本条文字生成。悬挂与落地方式服从实物结构，多摆位先确认同时或替代展示、逐载体分配与售卖范围，不能以构图为由忽略数量含义。
cards.usage: 上传自己的商品照片，复制中文到 GPT Image 2 或 Lovart；目标背景与构图已写入正文，无需上传库内预览图。
cards.prompt:
PRODUCT-EVIDENCE PRECONDITIONS
Apply the task below only to parts, views and states supported for this actual SKU. Confirm necessary dimensions, materials, quantity and sale contents from SKU-specific records or the user; photos support only clearly visible appearance, not guessed measurements or material composition. A material name does not authorize unseen fibers, veins, seams, pores, gloss or hidden construction. Use details only where the actual source resolves them; sharpening, relighting or upscaling must not manufacture detail. If an indispensable fact, view or texture is missing or contradictory, ask the user for that specific input and wait before this dependent image. Request a clear same-product photo when needed. Do not infer an answer from templates, competitors, generated images or silence. Omit an optional unsupported claim; obtain a choice before changing a required view, panel count or information task. Design delegation covers styling, not product facts. New backgrounds and non-included props may follow the authorized design, but must not change merchandise identity or scale.

Create one photorealistic commercial product image.

Build a deep-blue night garden bed with low flowers, a little lawn texture and softened dark-green trees behind. Let verified point lights create local color while the wider environment stays dark.

Show staggered near and far installations of the actual product, larger in front and smaller behind. Preserve its genuine radial branches and emitter positions, readable stakes, individual light edges and dark gaps.

Use actual same-SKU photos for visible merchandise identity: resolved shape, color, connections and surface appearance. Establish material composition and sale contents separately from SKU records or user confirmation; a photographed container is not automatically included. Preserve supported internal composition and proportions within each instance while allowing the specified framing, lighting and placement.

The input white backdrop, original surroundings and studio shadow are not the output setting. Extract the product, build the complete environment specified below and relight it, rather than merely adjusting exposure on white.

Resolve support from the actual merchandise. Suspend a basket with genuine hook or chains from a plausible environmental fixing, keeping its original load path continuous and air below the base, with no tabletop placement or elliptical floor-contact shadow. Ground a floor or tabletop product on a real support. Do not add chains to a floor product or replace an included container to fit the setting.

Create a low-light display of the actual point-light cluster. Follow the prescribed composition and retain depth between emitters, connecting rods and supports, with real spacing and open gaps against a softly layered background. Keep each bright point bounded and use only localized bloom, separating dark rods with modest ambient light. Obtain current-product lit-state evidence for actual color and emitter positions. Do not add branches or lights, merge points into glowing balls, draw firework trails or use blur to hide missing construction.

Make the merchandise the primary focal point with perspective, support and shadows belonging to one physical space.

Render as photorealistic commercial photography with readable merchandise and immediate support, physically coherent depth of field and source-supported material texture. Add no unsupported foliage or accessories. Render only explicitly supplied copy and add no feature badges or watermark. Preserve genuine existing product marks.

Before multiple placements, confirm whether they are simultaneous arrangements or separate alternative-use views. Map each actual product/color and allocated quantity to its container. For a simultaneous one-pack display, allocations must not exceed the confirmed pack contents; additional packs or separately sold products need an explicit display decision and clear purchase meaning. Do not clone a full pack into every container or mix variants by default.

Follow explicit user canvas and format instructions first. Otherwise return one finished sRGB PNG at 1600 by 1600 px. Fit the prescribed regions into this canvas with the required product outline and annotations intact. Add no before-and-after comparison, design explanation or extra frame unless this task explicitly requires it.

【产品事实前置条件】

【生成目标与版式】
请用我上传的实际花材生成暖米白色的编辑式尺寸信息图。左侧为较宽的主商品区，右侧为较窄的套装色组列；底部有淡木色台面。左侧完整主束保持真实花色与枝条，左外侧标总高、花冠上方标冠幅、下部裸杆旁标裸杆长度。右侧把已确认包含的各色组分别放入浅色圆角卡片中，每卡显示相应实际数量，卡片数量随真实色组增减。标题用清楚的衬线字体，小副标题疏朗排列；尺寸线用克制橄榄绿。

【实际数据与文案】
总高：【填写总高与单位】
冠幅：【填写冠幅与单位】
裸杆长度（最低杆端至第一分枝汇合处）：【填写裸杆长度与单位】
套装色组、各组数量及售卖单位：【填写实际色组与件数；不展示套装则填写“无色组列”】
主标题：【填写主标题原文；无需则填写“无标题”】
副标题：【填写副标题原文；无需则填写“无副标题”】
无色组列时移除右侧色卡并扩展主商品区；不添加总包数量徽章，不改变商品本身花色。

【输入用途】
同款实拍提供清楚可辨的形状、颜色、连接及表面外观。材质成分与随货范围另据对应SKU资料或用户确认，照片中的容器不自动视为随货。保留有依据的内部组成与比例；按本条规格调整取景、布光和摆放。

【真实数据】
尺寸由用户提供，部位、数值、单位和测量端点缺失或含糊时先询问，资料齐全后生成尺寸图。数值和单位原样显示，不估算、不自动换算。各尺寸线从对应视图的真实端点引出，数字不遮挡商品。局部放大视图不代表额外件数，也不与完整视图共用比例尺。

【文字与事实】
文案逐字使用用户提供的原文，未提供时先询问，或由用户明确选择无文案版；无文案时移除文字条，不能印占位符或开关说明。尺寸、件数、操作方法与工作状态只用用户资料，不从图片猜测。

若商品含挂钩和链条，全貌区必须完整保留原挂钩与链条，让篮底悬空展示：不把吊篮放在台面上，不画篮底接触影、地面或地平线。局部圆窗只裁取真实部位，无须重复整个悬挂结构。实际落地商品才在真实底座处保留轻微接触影。

测量线、数值和单位与实际部位一一对应，标注、商品和画布外缘之间留足间距。

用户明确指定的画布与格式优先；未指定时输出一张 1600×1600 px 的 sRGB PNG 完成图。把本条各区适配进画布，商品与所有必要标注完整入画；除本条明确要求的拼版外，不添加前后对比、设计说明或额外边框。

【细节窗口对应】
先把每个指定部位对应到同款清晰实拍。模板部位名称不证明商品具备该结构；必要部位不存在或看不清时先询问替换部位或修改版式，不补造。

【生成目标与版式】
请用我上传的花材生成白底尺寸与三圆窗细节图。左侧大幅展示完整主束，在左外侧标总高，在下部裸杆旁标裸杆长度。左上放小型深橄榄色标题签。右侧从上到下排列三个等大圆形细节窗，依次为真实花簇、可见叶杆连接处、可见分枝汇合处。使用纤细描边，圆窗下方留出短说明空间。左右及底部预留足够空间，箭头、数值与单位全部在画布内。

【实际数据与文案】
总高：【填写总高与单位】
裸杆长度（最低杆端至第一分枝汇合处）：【填写裸杆长度与单位】
左上标题：【填写标题原文；无需则填写“无标题”】
三圆窗对应短说明：【填写三条对应文案；无需则填写“无说明”】
不需要标题或说明时删除对应文字块，将空间留给图像。只显示外观细节，不自动加“丝绸”“可弯折”等材质与性能结论。

【输入用途】
同款实拍提供清楚可辨的形状、颜色、连接及表面外观。材质成分与随货范围另据对应SKU资料或用户确认，照片中的容器不自动视为随货。保留有依据的内部组成与比例；按本条规格调整取景、布光和摆放。

【真实数据】
尺寸由用户提供，部位、数值、单位和测量端点缺失或含糊时先询问，资料齐全后生成尺寸图。数值和单位原样显示，不估算、不自动换算。各尺寸线从对应视图的真实端点引出，数字不遮挡商品。局部放大视图不代表额外件数，也不与完整视图共用比例尺。

【文字与事实】
文案逐字使用用户提供的原文，未提供时先询问，或由用户明确选择无文案版；无文案时移除文字条，不能印占位符或开关说明。尺寸、件数、操作方法与工作状态只用用户资料，不从图片猜测。

【全貌区支撑】
若商品含挂钩和链条，全貌区必须完整保留原挂钩与链条，让篮底悬空展示：不把吊篮放在台面上，不画篮底接触影、地面或地平线。局部圆窗只裁取真实部位，无须重复整个悬挂结构。实际落地商品才在真实底座处保留轻微接触影。

【分区布光】
各全貌与近拍采用一致的左前上方宽柔主光、较弱右侧补光与中性白平衡；瓣层、叶缘和真实连接的微小遮挡影保留。近拍背景不画全商品落地影，只有完整落地商品在实际底座保留窄接触影；步骤照片各自保持受力与影向合理。

【输出规格】
用户明确指定的画布与格式优先；未指定时输出一张 1600×1600 px 的 sRGB PNG 完成图。把本条各区适配进画布，商品与所有必要标注完整入画；除本条明确要求的拼版外，不添加前后对比、设计说明或额外边框。

【字体与保护区】
单图全部文字、数字和单位使用同一可读字族，以字号、字重、字距和协调配色建立层级；展示字只在清楚可读时使用。保留本条指定的标题条、斜切底板、外框或彩色页脚，不固定棕白或黑字。文字、填充框、长笔画及字效避开完整商品加缓冲。明确无字或仅原生字段的选择优先；prompt中的字体名不证明已加载字体。

cards.prompt:
PRODUCT-EVIDENCE PRECONDITIONS
Apply the task below only to parts, views and states supported for this actual SKU. Confirm necessary dimensions, materials, quantity and sale contents from SKU-specific records or the user; photos support only clearly visible appearance, not guessed measurements or material composition. A material name does not authorize unseen fibers, veins, seams, pores, gloss or hidden construction. Use details only where the actual source resolves them; sharpening, relighting or upscaling must not manufacture detail. If an indispensable fact, view or texture is missing or contradictory, ask the user for that specific input and wait before this dependent image. Request a clear same-product photo when needed. Do not infer an answer from templates, competitors, generated images or silence. Omit an optional unsupported claim; obtain a choice before changing a required view, panel count or information task. Design delegation covers styling, not product facts. New backgrounds and non-included props may follow the authorized design, but must not change merchandise identity or scale.

DETAIL-REGION MAPPING: Before this layout, map each named part to a resolved same-SKU photo. A template label does not establish that a part exists. If a required part is absent or unclear, ask to replace that region or change the selected layout; do not manufacture it.

Create a forest-green dimension-and-detail layout. Separate a large white hero region at left and lower center from the green right background with a broad smooth curve from upper-left toward lower-right. Keep the complete bouquet and total-height annotation on white. Stagger three real flower, leaf and stem-connection circles along the right curve, with restrained decorative white dashes on the green side and short supplied captions nearby. Decorative dashes must remain separate from measurement lines. Preserve the broad high-contrast top title band only for supplied title copy; an explicit no-copy choice removes text blocks without deleting required dimensions. Add no count badge unless its actual count and sale unit are supplied.

Use actual same-SKU photos for visible merchandise identity: resolved shape, color, connections and surface appearance. Establish material composition and sale contents separately from SKU records or user confirmation; a photographed container is not automatically included. Preserve supported internal composition and proportions within each instance while allowing the specified framing, lighting and placement.

Before generating this dimension image, require the user to upload the actual product image and provide the specific measurements to display, including the measured part or endpoints, numerical value and unit. If any required measurement is missing or ambiguous, ask the user for that information and wait before generating the dimension image. Never infer dimensions from the photograph, a layout example or a hand. Do not substitute an unlettered base for the requested dimension image. Keep user-supplied numerical values and units exactly as given; do not invent conversions.

If the requested layout includes a heading, feature caption, step description or other product copy, require the user to provide the corresponding wording for each text region. If wording is missing, ask the user to supply it or explicitly choose a no-copy version, and wait for that choice before producing the text-bearing graphic. Preserve supplied wording; translate only if the user requests it, without adding claims. Do not automatically write slogans, material claims, performance statements or decorative pseudo-text. An explicitly requested no-copy version removes heading and caption bars and returns their space to photographs; it still retains the verified measurements in a dimension image.

The source backdrop, old page layout and studio shadow are not merchandise identity. Build the explicitly prescribed colors, regions, views and windows without automatically adding cards, caption strips or props. When this task explicitly assigns residential usage, an operation step or a night scene, establish that environment only within its own photograph; retain the prescribed background elsewhere.

If the product has a hook and chains, retain them completely in the whole-product region and keep the basket base suspended. Do not place a hanging basket on a tabletop and add no base-contact shadow, ground or horizon. Detail circles crop genuine regions without repeating the entire suspension. Only a genuinely standing product receives a light shadow at its real base.

Match whole and close views with a broad upper-front-left key, weaker right fill and neutral white balance, retaining small genuine overlap shadows at petals, edges and connections. Do not place whole-product floor shadows behind close-ups; only a complete grounded product receives narrow actual-base contact. Each action photograph must retain coherent support and shadow direction.

Match every measurement line, value and unit to the actual region with clear spacing from product and canvas edges.

Render as photorealistic commercial photography with readable merchandise and immediate support, physically coherent depth of field and source-supported material texture. Add no unsupported foliage or accessories. Render only explicitly supplied copy and add no feature badges or watermark. Preserve genuine existing product marks.

Follow explicit user canvas and format instructions first. Otherwise return one finished sRGB PNG at 1600 by 1600 px. Fit the prescribed regions into this canvas with the required product outline and annotations intact. Add no before-and-after comparison, design explanation or extra frame unless this task explicitly requires it.

TYPOGRAPHY AND CLEARANCE
Use one readable type family for every visible word, number and unit in this image; vary size, weight, spacing and coordinated color within that family. Use expressive display forms only where readable. Preserve the selected source's title strip, angled panel, frame or colored footer when prescribed; do not force every image to brown/white or black type. Keep type, filled shapes, swashes and shadows outside the full merchandise plus breathing space. An explicit no-copy or native-text-only choice takes priority. A font name in a prompt is not proof of an actually loaded font.

cards.prompt:

Before handoff, replace generic references and conditional choices below with this asset's actual uploaded filenames and roles, verified dimensions, exact sale quantity, supported placement and exposure, chosen copy and typography, and one resolved canvas. Resolve missing required facts with the user; these design instructions supply no product facts. Do not send unresolved branches or this editorial preamble to the image generator.

IDENTITY AND OUTDOOR FIT
Use only the actual same-SKU photographs for resolved appearance, intrinsic color, shape, component count and supported views. Establish measurements, included parts, mounting method and permitted outdoor conditions from the current SKU records or user confirmation. Keep product and prop roles explicit. A roof, competitor image or material name does not establish rain, UV, heat or wind performance. Do not add coatings, wiring, lights, foliage or a different base. Preserve true product-to-support scale and documented stem/container geometry. Keep borrowed scenery separate from merchandise.

LAYOUT BLUEPRINT
Design one wide A+ hero with a 1464-by-600 desktop master unless the approved slot requires another canvas. Build a residential courtyard with a rear doorway, pale wall and paved foreground. Put the complete actual product and its approved support in the right portion, inside 5% safe margins. The left portion is calm architecture for the exact selected headline and short supporting line, or remains clean when text is native to A+. Use a wider camera position to retain the product from top to base; do not crop a square scene into the banner or enlarge a small plant to doorway height. Keep props sparse and the setting recognizably outdoors.

LIGHT AND SHADOW
Use morning side light from upper left, a coherent soft floor shadow and neutral sky fill. Give the product sufficient local contrast against the wall while keeping the copy area quiet.
COPY AND FINISH
The agent first collects the user's base copy and font choice. Polish supplied copy without adding claims, or write it after explicit delegation or an actually submitted blank input. Resolve the final text and type system before handoff: one clear headline, smaller supporting text and subordinate labels as needed, with deliberate weight and color hierarchy. Preserve an explicit no-copy or native-A+ text choice. Keep all glyphs and effects outside the complete product silhouette plus a breathing buffer. Deliver photorealistic commercial photography with true texture and coherent perspective; no unrequested badges, watermarks or invented performance labels.

OUTPUT
One A+ image asset; default desktop master 1464 x 600 px, or the explicitly confirmed slot adaptation. Resolve the canvas before handoff; account upload acceptance remains a separate check.

cards.prompt:
Create one finished 1600×1600 px sRGB commercial image, unless an explicit user canvas overrides it. This is a secondary listing image; maintain the selected square canvas. Use the attached layout reference identified as B07ZCBVV19-G02 only for the following source-specific design.

Use the actual uploaded same-SKU photographs as the sole merchandise identity source: preserve resolved shape, color, part proportions, stem branching and visible surface appearance. The named competitor image supplies layout and photographic direction only. Never inherit its brand, botanical name, numerical measurements, pack size, material, attachments or performance claims. Before this template becomes a final generation prompt, the planning agent must resolve necessary missing facts/views with the user in a popup; do not invent hidden texture, joints or operating states. Replace generic roles with exact uploaded filenames, verified values and approved literal English copy. Use source-supported parts only. For stem arrangements, resolve each vessel's external height, usable insertion depth, whole stem length, decorative-body length, exposed bare stem and any authorized lower-stem trim. Lock physical size between scenes; change exposure and framing with vessel geometry, never rescale the product. Resolve a per-vessel quantity map and a real pack-density reference: preserve documented fullness without cloning units or implying one pack fills all repeated vessels. Different panels are alternative uses unless explicitly planned as simultaneous contents. For an outdoor scene, confirm the actual placement/exposure it requires. Outdoor styling alone proves no rain, UV, wind, frost or electrical rating. Keep source props subordinate and distinguish them from sale contents. 

LAYOUT BLUEPRINT
Single square porch scene, diagonal steps and white railing; four wood or woven vessels stagger from rear left to foreground right. The front-right arrangement leads, with small pumpkins below. No overlay text.

LIGHT, DEPTH AND SHADOWS
Directional daylight from upper right, shaded doorway, attached contacts on separate steps and oblique cast shadows following the boards. Retain realistic foreground/middle/background depth; keep the principal product silhouette clear and merchandise more salient than props. Contacts follow actual supports; hanging objects stay suspended, and every cast shadow follows its receiving plane.

COPY AND COLOR
Render no overlaid text, badges or captions. Any approved A+ explanatory text belongs in native fields outside this image. Use one readable type family for every visible word, number and unit in this image; vary size, weight, spacing and coordinated color within that family. Use expressive display forms only where readable. Preserve the selected source's title strip, angled panel, frame or colored footer when prescribed; do not force every image to brown/white or black type. Keep type, filled shapes, swashes and shadows outside the full merchandise plus breathing space. An explicit no-copy or native-text-only choice takes priority. A font name in a prompt is not proof of an actually loaded font.

Return one complete photorealistic image. Preserve actual product color in both highlights and shadows; do not transplant competitor merchandise, house numbers or logos, fabricate fine texture, or add a watermark. The prompt specifies an intended adaptation, not verified rendered fidelity.

Create one finished 1600×1600 px sRGB commercial image, unless an explicit user canvas overrides it. This is a secondary listing image; maintain the selected square canvas. Use the attached layout reference identified as B07ZCBVV19-G04 only for the following source-specific design.

Use the actual uploaded same-SKU photographs as the sole merchandise identity source: preserve resolved shape, color, part proportions, stem branching and visible surface appearance. The named competitor image supplies layout and photographic direction only. Never inherit its brand, botanical name, numerical measurements, pack size, material, attachments or performance claims. Before this template becomes a final generation prompt, the planning agent must resolve necessary missing facts/views with the user in a popup; do not invent hidden texture, joints or operating states. Replace generic roles with exact uploaded filenames, verified values and approved literal English copy. Use source-supported parts only. For stem arrangements, resolve each vessel's external height, usable insertion depth, whole stem length, decorative-body length, exposed bare stem and any authorized lower-stem trim. Lock physical size between scenes; change exposure and framing with vessel geometry, never rescale the product. Resolve a per-vessel quantity map and a real pack-density reference: preserve documented fullness without cloning units or implying one pack fills all repeated vessels. Different panels are alternative uses unless explicitly planned as simultaneous contents. For an outdoor scene, confirm the actual placement/exposure it requires. Outdoor styling alone proves no rain, UV, wind, frost or electrical rating. Keep source props subordinate and distinguish them from sale contents. 

LAYOUT BLUEPRINT
One close photographic view: the main cluster occupies the left and middle eighty percent, with the supporting wood barrel below; a small rear-right cluster and burlap establish depth. No text or inset.

LIGHT, DEPTH AND SHADOWS
Natural upper-right sidelight, retained gaps between flowers, crisp barrel contacts and gradual background defocus. Retain realistic foreground/middle/background depth; keep the principal product silhouette clear and merchandise more salient than props. Contacts follow actual supports; hanging objects stay suspended, and every cast shadow follows its receiving plane.

COPY AND COLOR
Render no overlaid text, badges or captions. Any approved A+ explanatory text belongs in native fields outside this image. Use one readable type family for every visible word, number and unit in this image; vary size, weight, spacing and coordinated color within that family. Use expressive display forms only where readable. Preserve the selected source's title strip, angled panel, frame or colored footer when prescribed; do not force every image to brown/white or black type. Keep type, filled shapes, swashes and shadows outside the full merchandise plus breathing space. An explicit no-copy or native-text-only choice takes priority. A font name in a prompt is not proof of an actually loaded font.

Return one complete photorealistic image. Preserve actual product color in both highlights and shadows; do not transplant competitor merchandise, house numbers or logos, fabricate fine texture, or add a watermark. The prompt specifies an intended adaptation, not verified rendered fidelity.

【事实与适配】以实际上传的同SKU实拍为唯一商品身份依据，保留清楚可辨的形态、颜色、部位比例、分枝和表面；竞品仅提供布局与摄影参考。不继承参考品牌、花名、尺寸、件数、材质、附件或性能。改成最终执行词前，规划agent对必要缺失事实或视角弹窗询问，不能编造隐藏纹理、接头和操作状态；把泛称换成准确上传文件名、已确认数值和逐字英文文案。散枝逐容器核对外高、内深、整枝、装饰主体、露茎和获准剪短量；换容器不缩放商品。按真实每包数量、每容器分配和疏密参考安排，不靠复制花材凑满，不暗示一包能填满所有重复容器。拼版默认为替代用途。确认画面所需室外摆放及暴露范围；室外造型不证明耐雨、UV、风、霜或电气等级。背景道具从属，随货范围单独明确。

【构图】左约65%完整枝束；右约30%竖排四个圆窗：花面、叶面、花群、分枝；标签在窗外，移除源UV图标及未证实卖点。

【光影】中性柔光保留实拍可见纹理，圆窗与整枝分视图，白底弱投影不制造额外浮层。前中后景有真实纵深，商品主轮廓清楚，承托和挂点符合本品；投影随承影面。

【文案与配色】执行前逐文字区写入准确英文、断行、字号、对齐和坐标，不印角色名或源话术；源件数与卖点换成本品已证实信息，必要内容缺失先问；原生A+字段单列。单图全部文字、数字和单位使用同一可读字族，以字号、字重、字距和协调配色建立层级；展示字只在清楚可读时使用。保留本条指定的标题条、斜切底板、外框或彩色页脚，不固定棕白或黑字。文字、填充框、长笔画及字效避开完整商品加缓冲。明确无字或仅原生字段的选择优先；prompt中的字体名不证明已加载字体。

只输出一张完整摄影成图。保留明暗中的真实固有色；不带入竞品商品、门牌、品牌、水印或编造细纹。提示词是拟实现设计，不是生图保真验收。

cards.prompt:
Create one finished 1600×1600 px sRGB commercial image, unless an explicit user canvas overrides it. This is a secondary listing image; maintain the selected square canvas. Use the attached layout reference identified as B0D5HKDBDN-G07 only for the following source-specific design.

Use the actual uploaded same-SKU photographs as the sole merchandise identity source: preserve resolved shape, color, part proportions, stem branching and visible surface appearance. The named competitor image supplies layout and photographic direction only. Never inherit its brand, botanical name, numerical measurements, pack size, material, attachments or performance claims. Before this template becomes a final generation prompt, the planning agent must resolve necessary missing facts/views with the user in a popup; do not invent hidden texture, joints or operating states. Replace generic roles with exact uploaded filenames, verified values and approved literal English copy. Use source-supported parts only. For stem arrangements, resolve each vessel's external height, usable insertion depth, whole stem length, decorative-body length, exposed bare stem and any authorized lower-stem trim. Lock physical size between scenes; change exposure and framing with vessel geometry, never rescale the product. Resolve a per-vessel quantity map and a real pack-density reference: preserve documented fullness without cloning units or implying one pack fills all repeated vessels. Different panels are alternative uses unless explicitly planned as simultaneous contents. For an outdoor scene, confirm the actual placement/exposure it requires. Outdoor styling alone proves no rain, UV, wind, frost or electrical rating. Keep source props subordinate and distinguish them from sale contents. 

LAYOUT BLUEPRINT
Left fifty-five percent: full spray with total-height and spread-width markers. Upper right: overhead spread; lower right: individual flower, each dimension anchored to its own verified endpoints. No inherited numbers.

LIGHT, DEPTH AND SHADOWS
Even soft sidelight on white, fine edges and clear dimension lines outside merchandise; inset scales remain explicitly independent. Retain realistic foreground/middle/background depth; keep the principal product silhouette clear and merchandise more salient than props. Contacts follow actual supports; hanging objects stay suspended, and every cast shadow follows its receiving plane.

COPY AND COLOR
Before execution, replace each described copy role with its exact project-approved English string, line break, size, alignment and bounds; do not print role names or source wording. Replace source counts/claims with verified SKU facts; omit an optional unsupported claim but keep its approved structural space or ask before changing the selected layout. Native A+ fields stay separate from baked-in copy. Use one readable type family for every visible word, number and unit in this image; vary size, weight, spacing and coordinated color within that family. Use expressive display forms only where readable. Preserve the selected source's title strip, angled panel, frame or colored footer when prescribed; do not force every image to brown/white or black type. Keep type, filled shapes, swashes and shadows outside the full merchandise plus breathing space. An explicit no-copy or native-text-only choice takes priority. A font name in a prompt is not proof of an actually loaded font.

Return one complete photorealistic image. Preserve actual product color in both highlights and shadows; do not transplant competitor merchandise, house numbers or logos, fabricate fine texture, or add a watermark. The prompt specifies an intended adaptation, not verified rendered fidelity.

【事实与适配】以实际上传的同SKU实拍为唯一商品身份依据，保留清楚可辨的形态、颜色、部位比例、分枝和表面；竞品仅提供布局与摄影参考。不继承参考品牌、花名、尺寸、件数、材质、附件或性能。改成最终执行词前，规划agent对必要缺失事实或视角弹窗询问，不能编造隐藏纹理、接头和操作状态；把泛称换成准确上传文件名、已确认数值和逐字英文文案。散枝逐容器核对外高、内深、整枝、装饰主体、露茎和获准剪短量；换容器不缩放商品。按真实每包数量、每容器分配和疏密参考安排，不靠复制花材凑满，不暗示一包能填满所有重复容器。拼版默认为替代用途。确认画面所需室外摆放及暴露范围；室外造型不证明耐雨、UV、风、霜或电气等级。背景道具从属，随货范围单独明确。

【构图】右侧约65%白色弧形大区放完整枝，最右彩色总长线和竖向胶囊标签；左30%背景虚化，三圆依次为叶、茎、花，白字短标签。

【光影】枝材柔光，左背景自然浅景深，圆窗纹理来自本品实拍；标签阴影只为易读不压商品。前中后景有真实纵深，商品主轮廓清楚，承托和挂点符合本品；投影随承影面。

【文案与配色】执行前逐文字区写入准确英文、断行、字号、对齐和坐标，不印角色名或源话术；源件数与卖点换成本品已证实信息，必要内容缺失先问；原生A+字段单列。单图全部文字、数字和单位使用同一可读字族，以字号、字重、字距和协调配色建立层级；展示字只在清楚可读时使用。保留本条指定的标题条、斜切底板、外框或彩色页脚，不固定棕白或黑字。文字、填充框、长笔画及字效避开完整商品加缓冲。明确无字或仅原生字段的选择优先；prompt中的字体名不证明已加载字体。

只输出一张完整摄影成图。保留明暗中的真实固有色；不带入竞品商品、门牌、品牌、水印或编造细纹。提示词是拟实现设计，不是生图保真验收。
